csm-common-sense-machines-api.notes: Service appears discontinued: csm.ai domains do not resolve (checked 2026-09-24).

hyper3d-rodin-api.free_tier: Paid only: API access requires the Business plan ($120/mo, $96/mo billed annually) or Enterprise; direct credits $1.5 each

sketchfab-data-api.auth_hint: Authorization: Token <API_TOKEN> (personal token) or OAuth2 Authorization: Bearer <access_token>; legacy v2 endpoints are deprecated
sketchfab-data-api.free_tier: Free: no key needed for search and model listing (GET /v3/search, /v3/models); downloads (/v3/models/{uid}/download) need a free account token

tencent-hunyuan3d-api.free_tier: Trial: 200 free credits one-time on first activation (valid 1 year); then postpaid $0.02/credit, Professional generation 25 credits (~$0.50), Express 15

tripo-api.free_tier: Trial: one-time free credits on first API key (amount varies by signup path, not listed on the pricing page); then pay-as-you-go at $0.01/credit
tripo-api.notes: MCP server by VAST AI Research (Tripo's developer) is alpha and works only through the Tripo Blender add-on (generate and import into Blender), not as a standalone API wrapper. Free-credit amounts vary; verify in console.

eraser-api-diagramgpt.notes: No free tier for API access - tokens are only issued to paid teams, not free accounts. The official remote MCP server (OAuth or API key; local npm @eraserlabs/eraser-mcp) is free within in-app free-tier limits.

icepanel-api.auth_hint: X-API-Key: <ICEPANEL_API_KEY>; OpenAPI 3.1 spec published at api.icepanel.io
icepanel-api.notes: Free plan has monthly request caps; higher volume requires Growth ($40/editor/mo), Scale ($80/editor/mo) or Enterprise. Official remote MCP (OAuth) is documented as paid plans only; the local IcePanel/mcp-server repo is deprecated.

lucid-lucidchart-rest-api.notes: Requires enabling Developer Tools on the account first; supports both API-key and OAuth 2.0 client-credential flows; exact free-tier API quota not published in docs. The official MCP server (OAuth, since 2025-11-18) must be enabled by an account admin.

miro-rest-api.free_tier: Free tier: up to 3 editable team boards; MCP on all plans, capped per day at 100 tool calls on Free (Starter 500, Business 2,000, Enterprise 10,000)

plantuml-server-api.notes: Extremely widely used for UML/C4/architecture-as-code; no signup; self-hostable via plantuml.war for privacy or rate-limit control. The official plantuml/plantuml-mcp is an MVP exposing only plantuml_version (no rendering yet).

structurizr.notes: Cloud service is end-of-life (migrate to playground, local or self-hosted server per docs.structurizr.com/cloud). Uses a nonstandard HMAC signing scheme rather than a bearer token; docs recommend the Structurizr CLI or client libraries over the raw API.

anthropic-claude-api.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <ANTHROPIC_API_KEY> (x-api-key still supported as legacy fallback), plus anthropic-version header

deepseek-api.notes: No native SDK: use the OpenAI SDK (base_url https://api.deepseek.com) or the Anthropic SDK (https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic). Off-peak is 50% off; peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri. Fees come from a topped-up or granted balance.

fal-ai.free_tier: Paid only: prepaid credits bought in advance; no free tier stated

hugging-face-inference-providers.free_tier: Free tier: $0.10/month in Inference Providers credits (PRO $2.00/month)

openai-api.notes: Docs moved from platform.openai.com to developers.openai.com (old URLs redirect). Usage-based billing with a payment method; rate limits scale with usage tier. The official MCP server is documentation-only and does not call the API.

together-ai.free_tier: Paid only: no free trial; minimum $5 prepaid credit purchase
